events.title: Nextfest!
events.summary: Hi all, we are participating in nextfest! We've updated the demo with a new hero trait, Plunder. Hope everyone enjoys playing :)

events.title: Fungites
events.summary: Hello Conquerors, we've recently had a few ideas that we're really excited about that will make the game more fun and replayable. But as it's not done yet it'll be revealed next patch. Anyway this patch has a lot to offer on it's own, small TLDR below.- 14 NEW Sleeves & 10 NEW Foods (also in the demo!)- Steady progress on finishing up the areas of the game (4/6 now complete)- Reduced price of a lot of shop items and rebalanced some others- Rebalanced some traits, mostly nerfs to those which play

events.title: Befre
events.summary: Hello Conquerors,This patch is rather brief as we spent a lot of our energy on adding the Demo steam page and updating the current one. The demo is also being updated to 0.12 to fix misc bugs.Content- Drew all Befre Cards + Enemies- Added Befre Theme- Added Bombard, Payback, Freeze, Ice VFX Balance- Reduced Hot Pepper's base price by 1- Changed Rage to trigger while sleeping- Changed Payback to deal 2X DMG when it triggersBugs- Fixed resolution and window mode bugs - Fixed misc bugs

events.title: Demo Out!
events.summary: Hello Conquerors, Our demo is now out to play! If you like it give us a wishlist, have fun ːsteammockingː

events.title: Demo Prep
events.summary: Hello Conquerors,If you are reading this and don't have a key, our demo is fast approaching. You can expect it within the next 1-2 weeks. This patch is really prep for the demo, but it has a lot of cool stuff and polish for those who have played before too :) Just look at this new stash screen!Shop ItemsAdded Lava Loaf item (playtester LavaLoaf)Added Cool Potato item (IOwnPotatoes playtester)Added Kachow Gummies item (Hubertinio playtester)Sleeve of Shine increased from +2HP -> +3HP and made it

events.title: Micropatch
events.summary: VFX- Added Ashbone Boss traits VFX Game Traits- Changed Plunder to: Gain 2X Gold when you win a combat- Added Plunder Hero Trait Upgrades: Fortunate, Promoted, Tough Money, Fat Pockets- Fortunate: Also upgrades the rarity of the lowest rarity card reward- Promote: Cards in card rewards may appear with higher levels- Tough Money: When your hero takes damage consume X Gold and deal 3X DMG- Fat Pockets: Start combat with extra health equal to your current Gold Bugs- Fixed Explosion triggers immedia

events.title: Shop Items & More
events.summary: I recognise the inherent funniness in creating an update post for a game that isn't publicly playable. This is more of a post to get the ball rolling, show that we're working on the game and let you guys know what kind of patch notes to expect in the future :) Shop Items- Lavender Tea: Give a card -X ATK and +X to all of it's traits- Sausages: Give the three lowest attack cards in your deck +X ATK- Lime: Give +2X to this card's lowest trait- Cherry Bomb: Give a random card +4X HP- Super Cola: Up

events.title: CtC Steam Page + Demo Info
events.summary: Hello Conquerors,Our Steam Page is now live after half a year of development and we're planning on releasing a demo in the next 1-2 months. The demo will include: 1 Playable Character70 Cards25 Shop Items2 WorldsWe will do bi-weekly content / feature patches that will be posted here in the future.If you like this game, give us a wishlist (it helps our motivation a lot).
